meta.title: PokéHax — Do you know Pokémon well enough to beat the Elite Four?
meta.description: Draft 6 Pokémon from Kanto and Johto and prove you know the franchise: the right team and order to beat the Elite Four and the Champion. Can you pull off the 6-0?

header.tagline:
Draft your team and face the Elite Four and the Champion.
Does your team go down — or pull off the **6-0**?

roll.hintDone: Team locked. Drag the cards to reorder who goes in first.

items.hint: Pick 1 item to carry on your journey — it lasts all 5 battles.

potion.name: POTION
potion.desc: Heals the Pokémon once per battle when its HP drops below 20%.

xspeed.desc: Max speed: this Pokémon always strikes first.

xdefense.desc: Takes 20% less damage in every battle.

intro.step1: **Draft your team.** Six rounds: each one offers 3 Pokémon (out of the 251 from Johto and Kanto) and you pick 1 for the slot.
intro.step2: **Don't like the 3? Skip.** A skip re-rolls that round's candidates — but it's limited, and how many you get depends on the mode.
intro.stepItem: **Choose an item.** With your team locked, a consumable comes in: pick 1 of 3 and apply it to a Pokémon — the effect lasts all 5 battles.
intro.step3: **Set the order.** With all 6 slots filled, drag the cards to decide who goes in first. The sequence is strategy.
intro.step4: **Defeat the Elite Four + the Champion.** Five matches, and the enemies get stronger each time — the Champion is the final wall. Pull off the **6-0**, or go down trying.
intro.cardP1: **POWER** is the Pokémon's base strength (the sum of its stats). The higher it is, the stronger it is by nature.
intro.cardP2: **CONDITION** is how that individual is doing this run — from POOR to EXCELLENT, shown by a colored arrow (Winning Eleven style). An underdog in excellent condition can surprise the Elite — that's why **every Pokémon is playable**.
intro.cardTip: The card above changes with the mode you choose below. ↓
intro.modeRocketDesc: You peek at the data: power and condition on display. Decisions with full information.
intro.modeOakDesc: Power turns into a "?" (you still see the condition). It's your Pokémon knowledge that builds the team.

body.p1: **PokéHax** is a fan game, **free and non-profit**, made independently by fans of the franchise. You draft a team of 6 Pokémon from Johto and Kanto and take on the Elite Four + the Champion. There's just one question: does your team pull off the **6-0**?
body.p2: Everything runs in your browser — it's a static site, no sign-up and no login. Made by **Lofz**, out of love for the franchise, in his spare time.
body.disclaimer: Unofficial project. **Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by** Nintendo, Game Freak or The Pokémon Company. "Pokémon", the creature names and other trademarks belong to their respective owners. Sprites and data are used solely for fan-tribute purposes.
body.linksIntro: Follow along, send feedback, or help keep the project alive:

privacy.p1: PokéHax is a simple site, with no sign-up and no login. **We do not collect personal data** such as name, e-mail or phone number. Your team and your choices stay only in your browser.
privacy.metrics: To understand how the game is used and improve it, we collect **anonymous statistics** (such as which mode was chosen and whether the run was completed). They **do not identify you**. Cookies are used for this — you can block them in your browser without affecting the game.
privacy.age: We recommend the game for those **aged 13 and over**. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
privacy.changes: This policy may be updated. When that happens, the "last updated" date at the top will change.
